card.name: Words where an explanation or excuse follows
card.fires_on: Words just before a reason or explanation is given, such as 'excused', 'explained', or 'in the absence of' other causative factors in WBC-decline warnings.

modes.label: Absence of other causes
modes.description: The words 'of' or 'other' in 'in the absence of other causative factors' after a white-cell decline warning.
modes.example: consider discontinuation of asenapine sublingual tablets at the first sign of a clinically significant decline in WBC in the absence<< of>> other causative factors.

modes.description: Verbs like 'excused' or 'explained' that lead into a stated reason.

modes.label: Asked why, he replied
modes.description: A pronoun in a story where someone is asked why and then gives a reason.
modes.example: When asked why he did not cut off his head,<< he>> replied: Some one had done that before
